result.summary: Found 1 content issue: a duplicate restaurant card is displayed in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant card (including the image, delivery time '15-25 min', title, and '€0.90 delivery' fee) is duplicated side-by-side in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the data source or fix the rendering loop for the 'Fastest near you' carousel so each restaurant appears only once.
